Game Overview

The Prison Escape is a racing title where throttle down dangerous lanes, master slick tap controls, and hunt down fleeing convicts in The Prison Escape. This exhilarating chase demands strategic timing and precision as you navigate treacherous paths, all while dodging obstacles and cornering prisoners. Are you ready to reclaim order?
